record_title: A mod-8 obstruction for odd divisor power means
scientific_context: A complete modulo-8 formula in the 2-adic integers for sigma_r(n)/tau(n) when n is odd and r is even, yielding the ±1 mod 8 obstruction for odd RMS numbers and generalized sigma-r numbers with r congruent to 2 mod 4.
limitations: Restricted to odd n for the residue obstruction. For r divisible by 4 the mean is always 1 modulo 8 and gives no residue restriction on n. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the empirical RMS residue observation itself is prior art on OEIS A140480, and older informal sequence discussion may be incompletely indexed.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact verification of the mod-8 theorem for 500,000 bounded (n,r) pairs and direct RMS testing for odd n<=200000.
Deterministic verification output reporting zero congruence mismatches and the bounded odd RMS residue check.
